headline: Six Sectors See Base Swaps as Toll Climbs
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the front‑line churn has spread to new ground. Weathered Expanse remains the war’s graveyard, its 24‑hour toll now 168,298 Colonial and 184,881 Warden dead with fourteen ownership changes; both casualty streams and enlistments are still accelerating. Linn Mercy continues to drive the heaviest fighting around Rotdust and Lathair, logging twenty‑two flips, 54,044 Colonial and 67,907 Warden casualties, and a sharp rise in recruitment. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to fourteen flips, Colonial losses at 49,541 and Warden at 61,917, with casualties and sign‑ups both accelerating. Stlican Shelf reports four flips, casualties climbing to 54,388 Colonial and 60,482 Warden, while loss rates cool. Deadlands adds five flips, its 24‑hour toll reaching 97,936 Colonial and 136,267 Warden dead, both sides’ loss rates now cooling. Fresh turnover appears on Farranac Coast (three flips in the last two hours, mixed 2‑Warden/9‑Colonial control), Fishermans Row (four flips, Fort Ember most active), and Gutter (five flips, The Parras busy). Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors still show no ownership changes.
